nodes.title: Recurrence for the α-Stirling entries

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\alpha$ be a sequence in $R$, and let $s_{i,j}$ ($i, j \ge 0$) be the α-Stirling entries of $\alpha$. Then $s_{i,0} = \alpha_1$ for every $i \ge 0$.
nodes.title: First column of the α-Stirling entries

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $\alpha_0, \alpha_1, \alpha_2, \dots$ be a sequence in $R$ ($\alpha_0$ is never used). The α-Stirling entries $s_{i,j} \in R$, for $i, j \ge 0$, are defined recursively by $s_{i,0} = \alpha_1$ for all $i$, $s_{0,j} = 0$ for $j \ge 1$, and $s_{i+1,j+1} = s_{i,j} + \alpha_{j+2} s_{i,j+1}$ for all $i, j \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Entries of the α-Stirling matrix

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\alpha$ be a sequence in $R$, and let $s_{i,j}$ ($i, j \ge 0$) be the α-Stirling entries of $\alpha$. For $n \ge 0$, the matrix $S_\alpha(n)$ is the $n \times n$ matrix over $R$, with rows and columns indexed by $0, 1, \dots, n - 1$, whose $(i, j)$ entry is $s_{i,j}$.
nodes.title: The α-Stirling matrix

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\alpha$ be a sequence in $R$, and let $u_{i,j}$ ($i, j \ge 0$) be the α-upper entries of $\alpha$. For all $i \le j$, $u_{i,j} = h_i(\alpha_{i+1}, \alpha_{i+2}, \dots, \alpha_{j+1})$, where $h_i$ is the complete homogeneous symmetric polynomial of degree $i$ in $j - i + 1$ variables.
nodes.title: α-upper entries are complete homogeneous symmetric polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\alpha$ be a sequence in $R$, and let $u_{i,j}$ ($i, j \ge 0$) be the α-upper entries of $\alpha$. Then $u_{1,1} = \alpha_2$ and $u_{1,2} = \alpha_2 + \alpha_3$.
nodes.title: Small α-upper entries

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\alpha$ be a sequence in $R$, and let $u_{i,j}$ ($i, j \ge 0$) be the α-upper entries of $\alpha$. Then for all $i, j \ge 0$, $u_{i+1,j+1} = u_{i+1,j} + \alpha_{i+1} u_{i,j} + (\alpha_{j+2} - \alpha_{i+1}) u_{i,j+1}$.
nodes.title: Recurrence for the α-upper entries

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $\alpha_0, \alpha_1, \alpha_2, \dots$ be a sequence in $R$ ($\alpha_0$ is never used). The α-upper entries $u_{i,j} \in R$, for $i, j \ge 0$, are defined recursively by $u_{0,j} = 1$ for all $j$, $u_{i,0} = 0$ for $i \ge 1$, and $u_{i+1,j+1} = u_{i+1,j} + \alpha_{i+1} u_{i,j} + (\alpha_{j+2} - \alpha_{i+1}) u_{i,j+1}$ for all $i, j \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Entries of the α-upper matrix

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\alpha$ be a sequence in $R$, and let $u_{i,j}$ ($i, j \ge 0$) be the α-upper entries of $\alpha$. For $n \ge 0$, the matrix $\mathsf{U}_\alpha(n)$ is the $n \times n$ matrix over $R$, with rows and columns indexed by $0, 1, \dots, n - 1$, whose $(i, j)$ entry is $u_{i,j}$.
nodes.title: The α-upper matrix

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $\alpha$ be a sequence in $R$. For every $n \ge 0$, the determinant of the $n \times n$ α-upper matrix $\mathsf{U}_\alpha(n)$ is $\det \mathsf{U}_\alpha(n) = \prod_{i=1}^{n} \alpha_i^{i-1}$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
